questionPayload.learningObjective: Identify the defining characteristic of the designated person or persons ashore under ISM Code Element 4 and their role as the link between the Company and those on board.
questionPayload.prompt: Under Element 4 of the ISM Code, which characteristic must the designated person or persons ashore have?

choices.text: Direct access to the highest level of management
A valid master's certificate of competency
Formal approval by the flag State administration
A permanent position on board one of the Company's ships
